final_message:
All tests pass! The fix is correct. All 5 tests are passing successfully, which means the LRUCache implementation is working as expected:

- Basic put/get operations work
- Missing keys return None
- Oldest entries are evicted when capacity is exceeded
- Get operations refresh recency (move accessed items to the end)
- Updating existing keys works correctly and doesn't increase cache size

The bug has been fixed and everything is fine.
